title: Social Media Content Creator - AI Images, Realistic Graphics & Metricool
description:
Grit Systems is a growing US-focused digital services company providing professional websites, CRM systems, lead generation tools and business automation services to American contractors.



We work with plumbers, roofers, electricians, HVAC companies and other home service businesses across the United States.



We are looking for a talented social media content creator to produce and schedule four months of professional social media content for our business.



This is a fixed-price project with the possibility of additional work in the future.



Project Overview



We require 120 high-quality social media posts, covering November 2026 through February 2027.



The content will be published across two Grit Systems social media accounts, with one post per day.



We want the content created, written, organised and scheduled in Metricool so that the entire campaign runs automatically.



The successful applicant will be responsible for completing the entire project from content creation through final scheduling.



Content Requirements



- Create 120 professional social media posts with engaging captions.

- Adapt and schedule the content across two social media accounts, approximately 240 scheduled publications in total.

- Use realistic photography, high-quality stock images and photorealistic AI-generated images.

- Create content relevant to American contractors and home service businesses.

- Feature professional website designs, lead generation, CRM systems and business automation.

- Showcase examples of websites we have built using actual screenshots provided by our company.

- Promote our website and CRM services, including our $295/month package.

- Create educational posts, promotional content, business tips and service highlights.

- Maintain consistent Grit Systems branding throughout.

- Include appropriate calls to action and relevant hashtags where suitable.



Important: Content Style



We want modern, realistic, premium-looking social media content.



We do not want cartoon illustrations, generic motivational graphics, cheap-looking templates or obviously artificial AI images.



Our preference is for realistic images of contractors working, genuine-looking business environments, modern website screenshots and professional advertising-style content.



You may use AI tools such as ChatGPT, AI image generators, licensed stock photography or professional graphic design software to produce the content.



Canva is optional. We are more interested in the quality of the finished content than which software you use.



All third-party images must be appropriately licensed for commercial use.



Metricool Scheduling



You must have experience using Metricool or be confident working with its content scheduling and bulk-upload features.



Your responsibilities include:



- Prepare all graphics and captions.

- Organise content into a structured posting calendar.

- Upload and schedule content directly in Metricool.

- Schedule daily posts across both social accounts for the agreed campaign period.

- Check that images, captions, links and publishing dates are correct.

- Provide all completed content files and editable source designs.

- Confirm that the posts have been correctly scheduled.



The objective is to have our social media accounts publishing automatically without requiring daily manual work from us.



Project Timeline



The project must be completed within 10 working days.



We will provide our website, logo, branding information, service details and examples of our contractor website designs.



The process will be:



1. Create the first 10 social media posts for approval.

2. Make any necessary adjustments based on our feedback.

3. Complete the remaining content using the approved style.

4. Begin scheduling approved posts while production continues.

5. Complete the full content library and Metricool scheduling.

6. Deliver all content files and confirm the scheduled publishing calendar.



Posts scheduled after approval should cover the remaining campaign dates through February 28, 2027. The complete content library must contain 120 posts.



Required Skills



- Experience creating professional social media content for businesses.

- Strong ability to generate realistic AI images and source professional stock photography.

- Excellent written English, particularly for American business audiences.

- Experience with social media scheduling tools, preferably Metricool.

- Good understanding of branding, visual design and content marketing.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

- Attention to detail and consistent design quality.



Experience creating content for digital marketing agencies, SaaS companies or US service businesses is an advantage.



Payment



Fixed Project Budget: $400 USD



This payment covers the creation of 120 posts, captions, graphics, content organisation, adaptation across two social accounts and complete Metricool scheduling.



We are looking for someone who works efficiently using modern AI-assisted content creation tools.



There may be further content projects available after successful completion.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. What experience do you have creating professional social media content?

2. Which AI image generation and editing tools do you use?

3. Have you used Metricool to schedule social media posts?

4. Can you share examples of realistic, professional social media graphics you have created?

5. Have you previously created content for US businesses?

6. Can you complete 120 posts, captions and scheduling within 10 working days for $400?

7. Are you available to start immediately?



Please include a link to your portfolio or examples of previous work.



Applications with professional, realistic content examples will receive priority.



We are ready to hire immediately.

, Vrbo and direct-booking performance

* Recommend improvements to listings and conversion

* Produce weekly and monthly revenue reports

* Proactively identify opportunities to increase revenue



Required Experience



You must have:



* 2+ years’ revenue management experience in hotels, serviced accommodation or STR

* Strong knowledge of Occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, booking pace, lead time and demand forecasting

* Experience with PriceLabs or similar dynamic pricing software

* Experience managing multiple properties/rooms

Our Systems

*

Not someone waiting to be told which prices to change.



KPIs

Occupancy • ADR • RevPAR • Revenue Growth • Profitability • Booking Conversion • Forecast Accuracy

title: Corporate Attorney – Healthcare Legal Operations
description:
Company: OCD Anxiety Centers

Location: Remote – Philippines

IMPORTANT: Applicants must hold an active license to practice law in the Philippines and must be admitted to the Philippine Bar.





About US:

OCD Anxiety Centers is passionate about bringing help and hope to individuals and families affected by anxiety and related disorders. We are an evidence-based behavioral health organization committed to providing effective, research-supported treatments and maintaining high standards of clinical care.



We provide specialized, evidence-based treatment programs through our network of treatment centers and virtual care services. Our programs serve individuals and families across multiple states in the United States, including Utah, California, Texas, Arizona, Colorado, Maryland, Virginia, and Washington, as well as additional markets through virtual treatment services.







The Team You Will Work With

You will work remotely from the Philippines as part of our corporate support team, collaborating directly with U.S.-based leadership and departments, including Human Resources, Operations, Clinical, Billing, and Compliance.



This position supports the company's corporate legal and operational needs across its multiple U.S. locations and business entities.



You will assist with contract management, corporate legal matters, healthcare documentation, HIPAA compliance, employment-law research, and other legal support functions that help keep our business operations organized, compliant, and running efficiently.



You will work closely with company leadership and appropriately licensed U.S. legal counsel, providing research, documentation, contract review, and compliance support to help address the legal and operational needs of a growing multi-state healthcare organization.



We are looking for someone who can work independently, communicate effectively with U.S.-based teams, manage confidential information responsibly, and contribute to a collaborative and accountable remote working environment.







Required Qualifications



- Active Philippine Bar membership and license to practice law in the Philippines (MANDATORY).

- Law degree and admission to the Philippine Bar.

- Strong knowledge of contract law and demonstrated experience drafting, reviewing, and analyzing contracts.

- Advanced proficiency using AI tools for contract review, including prompt design, clause comparison, iterative refinement, and independent verification of AI-generated results.

- Hands-on healthcare experience handling medical records and submitting records to healthcare payers.

- Practical experience applying HIPAA privacy and security requirements when handling protected health information.

- Experience supporting U.S. HR and employment-law matters, particularly California employment law.

- Willingness to learn and develop knowledge of employment requirements across multiple U.S. states.

- Excellent legal research, writing, drafting, and analytical skills.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Excellent attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate with a remote U.S.-based team.





Preferred Qualifications



- Five or more years of legal experience.

- Experience supporting U.S.-based companies, corporate legal departments, or international legal teams.

- Experience in healthcare or behavioral health organizations.

- Experience supporting companies operating across multiple U.S. states.

- Experience developing legal playbooks, employment-law references, and standardized legal operations processes.





Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

- Complete contract reviews, legal research, and document preparation accurately and within agreed timelines.

- Produce clear contract-review summaries with AI-generated findings verified against source agreements and reliable legal resources.

- Prepare and submit approved medical records to payers within applicable deadlines.

- Follow HIPAA and company privacy and security procedures.

- Provide timely and accurate California employment-law research and maintain updated references for the company's 10 operating states as assigned.

- Keep legal trackers, contracts, templates, and medical-record request logs organized and up to date.

- Identify and promptly escalate legal, employment, privacy, and compliance concerns.

- Provide timely status updates and complete follow-up actions with internal teams and outside counsel.



Performance Growth



As performance goals are consistently achieved, the supervisor will review progress and establish additional goals to support professional growth, improve contract-review processes, strengthen medical-record workflows, expand employment-law knowledge, and meet the company's evolving legal support needs.





Scope of the Role

This is an offshore paralegal and legal support position based in the Philippines. The role provides legal research, documentation, contract support, medical-record coordination, and compliance support to the company's U.S. operations.



Matters requiring U.S. legal advice or representation will be referred to appropriately licensed U.S. counsel and handled in accordance with applicable licensing requirements.





How to Apply

 - If you are confident that your experience and qualifications align with this role and you are comfortable performing the responsibilities outlined above, we would love to hear from you.



 - Please submit your most recent resume/CV and a short introductory video highlighting your legal background, relevant experience, and why you believe you are a good fit for this position.



- Please make sure to include your Philippine Bar admission and relevant experience supporting U.S.-based companies, particularly in contract law, healthcare documentation, HIPAA compliance, and employment-law matters.

title: Payroll/ Finance Operations Accountant
description:
About the role

Ceterus Bookkeeping owns our general ledger, monthly close, and financial statements; that does not change. This role makes sure Ceterus gets everything it needs, cleanly and on time, and owns what Ceterus does not: bi-weekly payroll in ADP, vendor accounts and timely payment, the working-capital KPIs (DIO, DSO, DPO, CCC), and the weekly and monthly report-outs that drive action. You will be the single point of contact for Ceterus, resolving their open items and blockers so the P&L, cash flow, and balance sheet are complete and holistic every month. The business has roughly 13 employees today; this role grows with us to 30+.

Key responsibilities

Bi-weekly payroll (ADP) – primary

• Run end-to-end bi-weekly payroll in ADP for all employees, on time and without error.

• Pull and reconcile hours, class and session counts, and commissions from Mindbody, the studio hours-tracking tool, and other systems before each run.

• Maintain employee records, tax setup, PTO, and new-hire/termination processing in ADP; support quarterly filings and year-end W-2/1099 processing.

• Deliver payroll registers and journal detail to Ceterus each pay period.

Ceterus hand-off and blocker resolution

• Capture every business receipt and expense (credit cards, reimbursements, vendor bills, subscriptions, cash) and transmit them to Ceterus, coded and documented, on their cadence.

• Own the Ceterus open-items list: answer questions, chase missing documentation, and clear blockers within two business days so the close is never held up.

• Reconcile Mindbody sales, merchant settlements, and bank activity weekly and flag variances to Ceterus before month-end.

• Deliver a complete, organized month-end package so Ceterus can produce a holistic P&L, cash flow, and balance sheet.

Vendor accounts and accounts payable

• Own all vendor accounts for goods and services: setup, W-9s, contact and terms records, portal logins, and account reconciliations.

• Collect, verify, and route vendor invoices for approval; schedule and release payments so every vendor is paid on time and to agreed terms, with no late fees or service interruptions.

• Maintain an AP aging and a weekly payment calendar; resolve vendor disputes and statement discrepancies promptly.

• Provide Ceterus with the complete, coded AP record each period.

KPIs and reporting – primary

• Build and maintain DIO, DSO, DPO, and CCC, including the definitions and data sources behind each.

• Identify what drives each metric and execute actions to improve them.

• Produce the weekly and monthly report-outs described below, going beyond the standard Ceterus financial package.

Administrative support

• Support ownership and the Studio Manager with other administrative tasks as needed (insurance, licenses, vendor contracts, benefits paperwork, franchisor reporting).

Reporting cadence

• Weekly (Monday): one-page cash and working-capital snapshot – cash position, DIO/DSO/DPO/CCC vs. prior week and target, top exceptions, and owner-assigned action items with due dates.

• Monthly (within 5 business days of Ceterus close): KPI trends (rolling 12 months), root-cause commentary, 13-week cash forecast, status of last month's actions, and defined actions for the month ahead.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting (or Finance with accounting coursework) and working knowledge of U.S. GAAP.

• 3+ years of accounting experience, including time at a public accounting or outsourced accounting firm.

• Hands-on ADP payroll experience (Run or Workforce Now), including tax setup and year-end processing.

• Experience pulling and reconciling reports from Mindbody or a comparable membership/POS platform.

• Fluent in DIO, DSO, DPO, and CCC: can calculate them, explain the drivers, and show actions you have taken to improve them.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets; clear written and verbal communication with non-financial owners.

• Authorized to work in the U.S.; able to pass a background and credit check.

Preferred

• CPA, CPA candidate, or CMA; experience working alongside an outsourced bookkeeping firm.

• Fitness, wellness, or franchise experience with recurring membership billing; QuickBooks Online familiarity.

Who you are

• Integrity first. You handle payroll, banking access, and employee data and act accordingly.

• Independent. You set your own calendar, hit your deadlines, and tell ownership what you need.

• An owner. You treat company cash as your own, catch problems early, and follow issues to resolution.

• Organized and professional. Your files and hand-offs are clean enough for Ceterus or anyone else to pick up without questions.

• Flexible. In a small company you will help outside accounting when needed, and you are glad to.

Compensation

Competitive salary commensurate with experience (range: 8.5/hr), As headcount passes 30, this role is expected to grow

Send your resume and a short note to describing one cash-cycle improvement you personally drove and its result.

title: Trade Data & Documentation Specialist (EUDR supplier data)
description:
TYPE OF EMPLOYMENT

Part-time, 20 hours/week (growth to full-time possible)



HOURS

Flexible, with at least 3 hours overlap with the Netherlands each working day:

4:00 PM – 7:00 PM Philippine time (winter), 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM (summer).



ABOUT US

Claeritas is a Dutch customs operations and trade compliance company. We help

European importers with their recurring customs and compliance work. We prepare

the work; our clients review and submit it themselves.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You start on our Border-Ready Data Desk. European importers of coffee, cocoa,

palm oil, rubber, soy and wood must collect proof from their suppliers under the

EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR). You make sure that data comes in, is complete

and is correct. Later you also check shipping documents for our customs clients.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Contact our clients' suppliers by
, phone and WhatsApp, in English

- Request and follow up geolocation data, production dates and legality documents

- Check received data against our checklist and flag what is missing or inconsistent

- Ask the supplier to correct data – never correct it yourself

- Prepare draft due diligence statements for our clients to review

- Keep the tracker and case files updated every day

- Write a short weekly status report per client

- Log your time per client and per task



WHAT YOU NEED

- At least 3 years in import/export documentation, freight forwarding, customs

  brokerage or supplier compliance

- You know invoices, packing lists, bills of lading and certificates of origin,

  and you notice when they do not match

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Persistent and polite: you follow up without being reminded

- Accurate in Excel or Google Sheets

- Stable internet, a quiet workspace, your own laptop

- Discretion with confidential client data



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with EUDR, sustainability certification or supplier audits

- Basic GIS: opening a GeoJSON file and checking a location on a map

- Knowledge of HS codes or EU customs

- Licensed Customs Broker, or a degree in customs administration, logistics or

  supply chain



HOW WE WORK

- You work from a written briefing and checklist; every result is checked by a

  second person before it goes to the client

- You use personal accounts only; no shared logins, no client data in personal

**We are looking for a highly experienced Shopify Store Scaling Expert who knows how to maximize revenue, increase conversion rates, boost average order value (AOV), and turn an existing Shopify store into a highly profitable eCommerce business.**



We don't need someone who simply manages a Shopify store. We need someone who understands the entire eCommerce customer journey, knows how to identify revenue opportunities, and can independently implement strategies that increase sales and profitability.



**Your main goal: Make our Shopify stores generate MORE revenue, MORE profit, and MORE sales from the traffic we already have.**



## Key Responsibilities & Required Skills



### 1. Offer Creation & Scaling

- Develop irresistible offers that increase purchase intent.

- Build product bundles, quantity breaks, and volume discounts.

### 2. Average Order Value (AOV) Optimization

- Develop checkout upsell strategies.

- Analyze AOV performance and continuously improve it.

- Improve revenue per visitor (RPV).

### 3. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

- Analyze and improve Shopify conversion rates.

- Optimize product pages for maximum sales.

- Improve homepage and collection page performance.

- Create high-converting landing pages.

- Optimize product descriptions and copywriting.

- Improve product images, videos, and visual merchandising.

- Implement trust badges, guarantees, and social proof.

- Optimize mobile shopping experiences.

- Reduce friction throughout the customer journey.

- Improve add-to-cart rates.

- Improve cart-to-checkout conversion.

- Improve checkout completion rates.

- Identify and fix conversion bottlenecks.

- Run structured A/B tests.

- Analyze heatmaps, scroll maps, and session recordings.

- Optimize page speed and user experience.

- Improve product page layouts and call-to-action placement.

### 4. Abandoned Cart & Checkout Recovery

- Build complete abandoned cart recovery systems.

- Set up abandoned checkout
 sequences.

### 5.
 & SMS Marketing

- Build high-converting automated
 flows.

- Welcome
 sequences.

 content.

 deliverability optimization.

We want someone who is **proactive, analytical, experienced, and obsessed with improving eCommerce performance.**

- Audit a Shopify store and immediately identify potential revenue leaks.

- Create a clear action plan to increase revenue and profitability.

- Build and manage a complete abandoned cart recovery system.

- Create and optimize offers, bundles, and upsells.

- Continuously test new strategies.

- Monitor performance and report measurable results.

- Take full ownership of store conversion and revenue optimization.

- Work across multiple Shopify stores when needed.

- Think like an eCommerce growth manager, not just a Shopify assistant.



## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Your performance will be evaluated based on improvements in:



- Conversion rate (CVR)

- Average order value (AOV)

- Revenue per visitor (RPV)

- Revenue and contribution profit

- Upsell and cross-sell revenue

- Abandoned checkout recovery rate

-
 and SMS attributed revenue

- Repeat customer purchase rate

- Customer lifetime value (LTV)

- Checkout completion rate

- Add-to-cart rate

- Overall store profitability



## Who We Are Looking For



**Required:**

- Proven experience scaling and optimizing Shopify stores.

- Strong experience with CRO, AOV optimization, and offer creation.

- Experience building abandoned cart and
 recovery automations.

- Ability to work independently and execute improvements.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Understanding of eCommerce profitability.

- Experience using Shopify apps and optimization tools.

- Excellent communication skills.

- Results-driven mindset.



**Big Plus:**

- Experience scaling 6-, 7-, or 8-figure eCommerce brands.

- Experience with direct-response eCommerce.

- Experience with paid traffic funnels (Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads).

- Experience with subscription-based eCommerce.

- Experience managing multiple international Shopify stores.

- Experience with Shopify Liquid or development.

- Experience running advanced CRO experiments.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. How many years of Shopify experience do you have?

2. Which Shopify stores have you personally optimized or scaled?

3. What is your biggest proven improvement in AOV or conversion rate?

 marketing tools have you used?

9. What is your expected monthly salary?

**Important:** We are NOT looking for a beginner, a general virtual assistant, or someone who only knows how to upload products.



We are looking for a **real Shopify growth expert who can identify opportunities, implement improvements, and consistently increase revenue and profit.**



**If you know how to turn Shopify traffic into more customers, larger orders, and repeat purchases, we want to hear from you.**

title: Project Coordinator | Work From Home | Philippines | Long-Term Opportunity
description:
We’re looking for an organized, proactive project coordinator based in the Philippines to help us plan projects, coordinate people, and keep work moving.



You’ll be joining a fantastic, well-established Philippine-based team supporting Mr. Supply Chain, LLC, an education and advisory business led by Daniel Stanton. Everyone works from home. We value clear communication, dependable follow-through, curiosity, and helping each other succeed.



Who you’ll be working with



Daniel Stanton, known as Mr. Supply Chain®, is a globally recognized supply chain expert, educator, and author of Supply Chain Management For Dummies and Project Management with AI For Dummies. His LinkedIn Learning courses have reached millions of learners around the world.



Our work connects supply chain management, project leadership, and technology. Supply chain projects often involve IT; robotics and automation; manufacturing, material handling, and packaging equipment; business process transformation; and collaboration with customers and suppliers.



We’re leaning into AI in all aspects of our business, including how we plan, coordinate, and deliver projects. This is an opportunity to work at the cutting edge of project management practices, applying AI to real work and helping us develop better ways of getting things done.



About the opportunity



This recruitment is exploratory. We have not yet signed the client contract that would support this initial assignment, but there is a high likelihood that it will move forward. We’re meeting strong candidates now so we can be ready when the agreement is finalized.



We’re looking for someone who can grow with our team over the long term. You’ll initially help us establish an effective project coordination process, then apply and improve that process across future projects. The start date and weekly hours will depend on the final agreement and workload.



What you’ll do



You’ll work closely with Daniel and our team to keep plans current, information organized, and commitments moving forward. Responsibilities will include:



► Building and maintaining project schedules, task lists, milestones, and dependencies in Smartsheet.

► Coordinating meetings, preparing agendas, documenting decisions, and following up on action items.

► Tracking progress, risks, issues, changes, and outstanding information.

► Preparing clear status reports and dashboards.

► Organizing project files and maintaining accurate documentation.

► Following up respectfully and persistently with people responsible for deliverables.

► Developing reusable templates, checklists, and procedures for future projects.

► Using AI to support planning, analysis, documentation, and communication while checking outputs for accuracy.

► Helping us identify and implement useful workflow automations.



You don’t need to be the technical expert on every project. You do need to ask good questions, understand who is responsible for what, and make sure important details don’t fall through the cracks.



What we’re looking for



► Practical Smartsheet experience, including schedules, dependencies, reports, dashboards, and automated reminders. Please describe what you have actually built or maintained.

► Experience coordinating projects with multiple stakeholders and deadlines.

► Strong written and spoken English.

► Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.

► Confidence asking questions, identifying gaps, and flagging problems early.

► An interest in building repeatable processes and improving how work gets done.

► Hands-on experience with AI tools and a willingness to keep learning and experimenting.

► Comfort using Google Workspace and video meetings.

► Reliable internet and a suitable work-from-home setup.

► Availability for some scheduled overlap with North American business hours.



A bachelor’s degree is preferred. Experience supporting client projects, working with a remote team, or coordinating supply chain, operations, or technology initiatives would be helpful.



Why join us?



You’ll become part of an established remote team with supportive colleagues and meaningful work. You’ll work directly with an experienced supply chain and project management educator, take ownership of project coordination, and help build processes we can use as the business grows.



You’ll also help put emerging AI-enabled project management practices into action. We want someone who brings ideas, exercises good judgment, and enjoys finding better ways to work.



We’re looking for someone who wants to become a trusted, long-term member of the team.



How to apply



Please include:



A brief introduction and an explanation of why this opportunity interests you.



Your résumé, including your education and relevant project experience.



Specific examples of your Smartsheet work. Screenshots or anonymized examples are welcome. Please do not share confidential client information.



An example of how you’ve used AI to improve your work, including how you checked the results.



Your availability, preferred weekly hours, and earliest start date.



Your expected hourly rate in USD.



A short example of a time you identified a project problem and helped resolve it.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to an interview and a small paid Smartsheet skills exercise.

title: Controller / Bookkeeper (Remote, Offshore)
description:
Company: Elevate Innovation is a design company that builds products and experiences for the spirits and cpg industry.



Role Summary



We’re hiring a hands-on Controller/Bookkeeper who owns day-to-day accounting (GL, AR, AP, cash) and builds the finance backbone for scale—policies, controls, and SOPs. You’ll manage billing and collections, vendor payments across multiple countries/currencies, job costing, inventory/COGS tracking, and monthly close, while leading process improvement and partnering with operations, sales, and our factory network.



What You’ll Do - Accounting & Close Wise



Own the full general ledger; prepare monthly/quarterly closes (target: T+7 business days) with accurate financials (P&L by project/client, balance sheet, cash flow).



Build and Improve chart of accounts and cost centers aligned to projects/jobs, departments, and manufacturing flows (USA/Colombia/Brazil/China/Intl).



Perform reconciliations: bank, credit cards, merchant accounts, cash advances, intercompany, inventory/WIP, deposits to suppliers.



Accounts Receivable (Order-to-Cash)

Convert quotes/POs/milestones into timely invoices; ensure backup (approved proofs, delivery notes).

Monitor aging; drive collections and dispute resolution; reduce DSO and chargebacks.

Maintain client vendor portals (EDI, statement uploads, compliance docs) and tax certificates as required.

Accounts Payable (Procure-to-Pay)

Implement 3-way match (PO • Goods/Services • Invoice) for factories, freight, and materials.

Schedule global payments (USD/COP/BRL/CNY) optimizing FX, fees, and early-pay discounts.

Keep vendor master data current; manage W-8/W-9, 1099 vendors (with CPA).

Cash & Treasury



Own weekly cash positioning and 13-week cash-flow forecast; track forecast-to-actual variance.

Manage deposits and stage payments to factories; align cash timing to project milestones.



Oversee corporate cards/expense reports; enforce spending policies.

Costing, Inventory & Project Finance

Establish job costing templates (materials, labor, freight, duties/tariffs, overhead, QC, packaging).

Track WIP and COGS recognition (by delivery or %-completion as appropriate)

Partner with ops on quotes, margin targets, and post-mortems (estimate vs actual).



Draft and enforce internal controls (approval matrices, vendor onboarding, segregation of duties, document retention).

Support logistics/compliance documentation (commercial invoices, HTS, duties).

Systems & SOP Leadership

Lead the finance tech stack: accounting, AP/AR automation, expense, payroll/contractor payouts, and BI dashboards.

Author SOPs for Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, and Project/Job Costing; train team and iterate.

Create reporting packs for leadership: monthly financials, KPI dashboards, project margins, pipeline-to-cash insights.

Success Metrics (KPIs)

Close timeliness: Monthly close completed by T+7 business days.

title: YouTube Scriptwriter — Unexplained Events & Mysteries
description:
I’m looking for an excellent, independent writer to create engaging YouTube scripts about unusual encounters, strange sightings, and unexplained events.



For examples of the writing quality I’m looking for—simple language, conversational delivery, and storytelling that’s extremely easy to follow—see:



• Carolina Case Files: 

• Lighthouse Mysteries: 

• MrBallen: 



PAY & DETAILS



• $100 USD per script, including research.

• 3,000–3,600 words per script.

• Freelance position with potential for ongoing work.

• Topics and writing guidelines will be provided.



INDEPENDENT WORK



You must handle each script independently, including research, fact-checking, structure, writing, and proofreading.



Every script must be finished and ready for narration when you submit it. I should not need to rewrite sentences, simplify the language, correct factual errors, or restructure the story.



The purpose of this position is to take scriptwriting off my plate. If I have to revise your work, this arrangement does not make sense for me. You need to understand the guidelines and consistently deliver finished scripts independently.



TOPICS



Strange sightings, unexplained events, and unusual encounters. No true crime. Choose stories with safe outcomes for everyone involved.



THE WRITING



Scripts must be extremely easy to follow, engaging, and natural when read aloud. Think of someone telling you a fascinating story in everyday language.



Absolutely no flowery language. None. No poetic descriptions, elaborate metaphors, or sentences dressed up to sound impressive.



For example:



• Don’t write: “An eerie silence draped itself over the sleepy town.”

Write: “The town was quiet.”



• Don’t write: “The moon cast its silver veil across the lonely stretch of asphalt.”

Write: “The moon lit the road.”



• Don’t write: “An icy wave of terror gripped him as he gazed upon the mysterious figure.”

Write: “He was frightened when he saw the figure.”



The writing must not sound AI-generated at all. No robotic phrasing, generic suspense lines, awkward transitions, or repeated points.



I want a strong opening, events presented in a clear order, and interesting details that hold the listener’s attention. Let the events make the story interesting.



Research each topic carefully, provide source links, and distinguish documented facts from witness accounts or speculation. Do not invent details or dialogue. Include pronunciation guides in parentheses for unfamiliar names and places.



TO APPLY



Use Ghost as the subject line of your application and include:



1. Why you would be a good fit, including any relevant writing experience.

2. At least one existing writing sample. Multiple samples are preferred.

3. Links to published videos using your writing, if available, and your role in creating them.

4. Your usual turnaround time for a 3,000–3,600-word script.



I’d like to find a dependable writer for a long-term working relationship.

title: Senior FFull-Stack Developer / Technical Lead – AI Platform Takeover
description:
We are a UK-based company developing a technology platform combining education, e-commerce, user accounts and an AI-powered assessment service.



The platform has already had development work completed by separate web and AI developers. We are now looking for an experienced senior developer to take technical ownership of the project, audit the existing work, consolidate the development environment and continue the platform through to production.



This is not a new build from scratch. Your first responsibility will be to understand, document and safely take over the existing development.



Current technology includes:



 WordPress



 WooCommerce



 TutorLMS



 Cloudways



 GitHub



 Python



 FastAPI



 REST APIs



 AI/LLM integrations



 databases and third-party services



The AI component has been developed separately as a FastAPI-based service and needs to be reviewed and integrated into the wider platform.

Your first assignment



Your first task will be a technical takeover and audit.



You will be required to review all GitHub repositories provided by the existing developers, independently back up the code, assess what is complete or incomplete, review the current web platform and AI service, identify missing dependencies, understand the current architecture, and confirm what is required to bring the system together.

I Development Responsibility



The platform includes an existing AI-powered skin assessment service that has been developed separately using Python/FastAPI. The successful developer will be expected to audit the current AI codebase, assess its quality and completeness, and determine whether it should be continued, refactored or partially rebuilt.



You may also be responsible for ongoing development of the AI functionality, including the assessment pipeline, API logic, prompts/model integrations, testing, optimisation, deployment and integration with the main platform.



We are therefore particularly interested in developers who are comfortable not only integrating AI services, but also taking technical ownership of an existing AI application and continuing its development where required.



You will also need to:



 review Git history and branches;



 assess the Python/FastAPI AI service;



 review the WordPress platform;



 review databases, APIs and integrations;



 review Cloudways/deployment setup;



 identify missing environment variables or credentials;



 identify security issues and technical debt;



 determine what is required to integrate the AI service with the web platform;



 confirm whether the project can be rebuilt and deployed without relying on the previous developers;



 produce a technical audit report;



 provide a clear roadmap for completion.



Once the takeover is completed, the role may continue into ongoing development.

Ongoing responsibilities



The successful developer may take responsibility for frontend and backend development, Python/FastAPI development, API integrations, AI service integration, WordPress customisation, WooCommerce and TutorLMS integration, database development, user authentication, deployment, testing, bug fixing, GitHub management, staging and production environments, documentation, security and backups.

Essential experience



We are looking for someone with strong experience in Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, JavaScript, PHP, WordPress, WooCommerce, MySQL/databases, Git/GitHub, cloud/server deployment, API integrations, debugging existing codebases and taking over projects from previous developers.



Experience with AI/LLM integrations, OpenAI or similar APIs, embeddings, vector databases, machine-learning pipelines or AI deployments would be highly desirable.

Important



We need somebody who is comfortable inheriting somebody else’s code.



Please do not apply if your normal approach is to automatically rebuild a project from scratch before properly reviewing the existing system.



Our priority is to preserve the work already completed and determine what can be reused before making any rebuild decisions.

 Tell us about a project where you took over an existing codebase from another developer.

Please begin your application with:



TECHNICAL TAKEOVER



Applications that do not include this will not be reviewed.

title: Customer support
description:
Read this entire post before applying. If you skim it, you will fail the application in the first five seconds and we will both have wasted our time. That is not a threat — it's a favor. This job is not for most people, and I'd rather you find that out now.





WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS

We are a Swedish e-commerce company running several brands. Every brand gets customer
s every day, and every one of them needs a correct answer the same day. Forever.



Your job: clear the support inboxes every day. Different brands, different languages, the same questions over and over:



"Where is my delivery?"

Order not received.

Product not as expected.

Returns and exchanges.

General questions about the brand.



The
s are boring. The job is not. Here is what a normal day actually looks like:



Open the inboxes. Look each order up in Shopify. Find the tracking. Reply in the customer's language using DeepL, following our reply guide.

When tracking has been dead for a week, you do not tell the customer "please wait." You message our shipping agents in China, get an answer, and then tell the customer what is actually happening and when.

When a customer opens a dispute with their bank, you collect the evidence — order, tracking, delivery proof, your
 thread — and submit it to the payment provider. Before the deadline. Without being reminded.

When the same problem shows up three times in one week, you write it down and tell us. Once, with numbers.



The tools: Shopify admin,
, DeepL, the carriers' tracking pages, the payment provider's dispute portal, and a chat with our China agents. We teach you our setup in week one. Shopify admin you must already know: previous hands-on experience in Shopify admin is required.





THE ONE THING THIS JOB IS REALLY ABOUT

We are in Sweden and we spend our days running ads. We are not going to sit next to you. If you message us "what should I do?" three times a day, this job has failed — for both of us.



The rule is simple. Before anything reaches us, you have already tried to solve it. When it still has to reach us, it arrives like this — four lines, nothing else:



The problem: Order 4471, tracking dead for 11 days, customer threatening a chargeback.

What I already did: Checked the carrier page, asked the China agent on Monday and again on Wednesday, no reply.

What I propose: Offer a replacement now, refund only if there is no scan by Friday.

What I need from you: A yes or a no.



That is the whole job in four lines. Anyone can answer "where is my order" when the tracking works. I am hiring the person who knows what to do when it doesn't — and who d
 first and asks second.



Quick question, and I mean it: a customer writes in Danish, and DeepL is down for the whole day. What do you do? Make your answer the very last thing you say in your application video. You'll see why below.





WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT, IN THIS EXACT ORDER

1. You show up. Every single day, Saturday and Sunday included. Not "most days." Not "I had internet problems." Every day.

2. The inbox is cleared inside your window, every day. Nothing sits for more than 24 hours without a reply.

3. You d
 first and ask second. Every time something reaches us, it comes with your proposed solution.

4. You stay. We are building a team, not renting an assistant for two months.

5. Your English and your tone are good enough — and get better.



Notice that skill is fifth on this list. That is not a mistake. The one skill you must bring is Shopify admin. Everything else we can teach you: our brands, our reply guide, our shipping, our tone — we have a whole system for it, and the person who reads this carefully and types "kanelbulle" as the first word of the subject line when applying is already showing me the exact trait I'm hiring for. It is not mentioned in the subject line structure below, but it is supposed to be the first word, then the structure. What we cannot teach is a person who opens the inbox every single day for the next two years, weekends included, and who would rather make a decision than wait for one.





HOURS — READ THIS PART HONESTLY

This is work on demand. There is no fixed shift. The rule is simple: the inbox is cleared every day, 7 days a week, inside 10:00–17:00 Swedish time. If you are in the Philippines, that window is 17:00–00:00 right now (16:00–23:00 in summer). You d
 when inside it. The workload has grown fast: right now the job takes several hours every day, and it keeps growing as we add brands and tasks. Weekends are never optional.



You log the hours you actually work, and you are paid for them. More hours come with more brands and more tasks.



If you cannot open the inbox every single day, including weekends, do not apply. That is the entire job.





PAY — READ THIS PART SLOWLY

Hourly rate, paid twice a month, on time, every time. We have never missed a payment and we never will.



The rate ladder, in writing:



Start: $2.50 USD per hour.

After 1 month: $3.00 USD per hour.

After 3 months: $3.50 USD per hour.

After 6 months: $4.00 USD per hour.



Every step is automatic if you are still clearing the inbox every day. It goes into your agreement on day one. You will never have to ask me for a raise, and I will never "forget." The first raise comes after ONE month. Not six. Not "we'll see." One month.



On top of that:



$20 USD consistency bonus every month you open the inbox on every single day with zero missed days. This is the easiest money in the job, and it is entirely within your control.

$3 USD per Trustpilot review. Every 4- or 5-star review from a real customer that mentions you by name. Uncapped, and this is the real upside. A customer who was angry on Monday and names you in a 5-star review on Thursday is exactly the job, and you get paid for it every time it happens. Each review is matched to a real order before it is paid.



One line on that, because it matters: you never ask a customer for a rating, you never offer a customer anything for a review, and you never write one yourself. One fake, bought or nudged review and the seat is gone the same day. The reviews you get paid for are the ones you earned by fixing the problem so well that the customer wanted to say your name.



You are paid for the hours you actually work, not for counting
s. Some days are calmer. Some days are a full inbox and a dispute deadline. Either way, the day is cleared.





WHAT COUNTS AS DONE

Every customer
 that arrived before 17:00 Swedish time is answered the same day, in the customer's language, following the reply guide, with the order looked up in Shopify. Every dispute is answered before its deadline. Anything that reaches us comes in the four-line format above. Not a taste judgment. If I send something back, I tell you exactly why in one sentence, and it counts once you fix it.





WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY

Please save us both the time. Do not apply if:



You cannot open the inbox every single day, Saturday and Sunday included.

Your internet is unreliable and you have no backup connection.

You have no plan for brownouts or power cuts.

You need someone to tell you what to do for each
.

You take angry customers personally, or argue with them.

You have never worked in Shopify admin for a real store. Not "seen it" — worked in it.

You are not comfortable recording a short video of yourself with your camera on.

You want to negotiate the rate upward before you've proven a single month.

You are looking for a placeholder while you search for something better.

You want the "future tasks" at the bottom of this post to be the job now. They come after months of a cleared inbox, not before.



I'm not being harsh for fun. I'd rather describe the job exactly than lose a good person who wanted a different one.





HOW TO APPLY — THIS IS THE FIRST TEST

Ninety percent of applicants will get this wrong. That's the point.



1. Subject line, formatted EXACTLY like this:

| [most customer
s you have ever answered in ONE day] | [years using Shopify admin] | [hours/day you can work] | [days/week you can work] | [your download speed from speedtest.net]



Example: XXXXXX | 45 | 2 | 2 | 7 | 40mbps



Wrong format or a missing field — deleted unread. If the Shopify field says 0, deleted unread. No exceptions, no second chances.



2. Your message contains ONE thing: a link to a Loom video. Nothing else. No written answers, no cover letter, no CV.



It must be Loom (
). Not YouTube, not Google Drive, not a file. The free Loom plan is enough. Set the link so anyone with it can watch. Maximum 5 minutes. In English. Camera on, your face visible the whole time.



In the video, cover these six things, in this order:



1. Who you are, and the most customer
s you have ever answered in one day. For which store, and what kind of tickets.

2. Your Shopify experience. Which stores, for how long, and what you actually did in Shopify admin. Then: the first thing you open in Shopify admin when a customer says the package hasn't arrived, and what you look at there.

3. Your setup. Computer, internet provider, backup internet, and what you do when the power goes out. Open speedtest.net on your screen and run it while you record. The number must match your subject line.

4. Longevity. The longest you have ever stayed in one role or with one client, how long, and why it ended. A short history with an honest reason beats an inflated one.

5. What would make you quit this job. Everyone has a breaking point. Tell me yours. I trust the person who names it far more than the person who says "nothing."

6. The last thing you say in the video: the answer to the question I asked you earlier in this post. If it isn't there, you didn't read the post. If it is, I already know two things about you.



Never show a client's Shopify admin, customer names or orders on your screen. Protecting customer data is part of this job, so it is part of the test.



3. If I message you, reply within 24 hours. If you don't, I move on to the next applicant. Answering fast is part of the job, so it is part of the test.





THE THREE STAGES

Stage 1 — The application above. A Loom of up to 5 minutes. Most people won't do it.



Stage 2 — The inbox test. Unpaid. If your video is sharp, I send you five real customer
s (names removed) in three languages, our reply guide, and access to DeepL. You return five written replies within 24 hours. One of the five has no answer in the guide. I am watching what you do with that one: guess, ask a smart question, or find it. Anything that has to reach me comes in the four-line format. I am not grading style. I am grading: did you follow the guide exactly, did you deliver on time, and did you d
 before you asked. This is a real preview of the daily job.



Stage 3 — Paid trial week on one brand's live inbox. Real customers, real China agents, real feedback. This is where the seat is won.





WHAT YOU GET IF YOU WIN IT

One company, several brands, the same people every day. You choose when you work inside the window. Pay on time, twice a month, without ever having to ask. A rate that grows on a schedule you can see, and hours that grow with the work. Someone who tells you exactly what's wrong in one sentence so you can fix it and get better fast.



And a real path. Once the inbox has been cleared every day for months, the next tasks are real: finding products, searching for ad videos, writing ad copy, product descriptions, talking to UGC creators and influencers. We train you for them. But that comes after, not instead.



And the upside has no ceiling: every customer who names you in a 4- or 5-star review is $3 in your pocket, forever, on top of everything above.



If you're the kind of person who is tired of clients who never answer, and who just wants a seat, a standard to hit, and to be paid reliably for hitting it — this is that.



Show me you can follow instructions, and show me you can d
. That's the whole first test.

title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer - Thumbnails for Viral Story and Commentary Channels
description:
We're hiring a thumbnail designer for our YouTube channels. Our first channel covers viral public i
: the "Karen" confrontations from TikTok and Instagram, told as 10–15 minute stories about who the person was and what it cost them. We'll add channels in other niches over time, so you'll design for different audiences. We're looking for someone to work with us on an ongoing basis.



A thumbnail has one job: make the right viewer click. For each video you'll get the title, a short summary of the story and the footage, and turn them into a thumbnail that reads in under a second on a phone.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Find the strongest frame in the footage: the face mid-yell, the moment of the shove, the reaction.



- Clean up stills from low-quality phone video: upscale, sharpen, fix the colour and light, and cut people out when the design needs it.



- Add short, bold text, usually 1–3 words, that adds to the title instead of repeating it.



- Deliver 2–3 versions of each thumbnail so we can test them against each other with YouTube's Test & Compare.



- Check every thumbnail at phone size before you send it.



- Save the layered source file (PSD or similar) next to each export in our shared Google Drive.



- Follow each channel's style guide, and suggest changes when a thumbnail underperforms.



THE STYLE FOR OUR FIRST CHANNEL



- One real frame from the clip, with the person's face large and mid-expression.



- The image enhanced so it looks sharp and bright, without looking fake.



- 1–3 words in a heavy font, bright yellow with a black outline, such as "FIRED!" or "WHAT HAPPENED?", sometimes with a smaller "*UPDATE*" underneath.



- Text on one side and the face on the other. No emojis, borders or clutter: the face does the work.



Every thumbnail must show what really happened in the footage and follow YouTube's thumbnail policies: no blood or graphic injuries, no made-up quotes, and children's faces blurred.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- A portfolio of YouTube thumbnails you designed, ideally for commentary, news, true crime, drama or reaction channels.



- Strong Photoshop skills (or similar): cutouts, colour grading, text effects and rescuing blurry frames from phone video.



- An eye for what gets clicks. You study what's working in a niche and can explain why a thumbnail works.



- The ability to keep up volume without the quality dropping.



- Good written English, so the words on a thumbnail are short and correct.



- Comfort working with heated footage, some of it offensive.



- Reliable deadlines and clear communication.



- Bonus: experience with YouTube's Test & Compare or with AI upscaling tools.



Workload: To start, 3–5 videos a week, each with 2–3 thumbnail versions. This will grow as we add channels.



Turnaround: Within 24 hours of receiving the title and footage.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word "guava" and include:



1. Your
 address



2. Your portfolio link (Behance, Google Drive or similar, set so anyone with the link can view)



3. Links to 3–5 YouTube videos that use thumbnails you designed (link the videos, not image files), and the channel each one is for



4. The YouTube channels you've designed thumbnails for, when, and how many thumbnails a week you made for each (or "none yet")



5. Your current workload: how many thumbnails you design in a typical week, for how many clients, and how many more a week you could take on for us



6. A thumbnail idea for this story: a man in a new pickup truck sprays a 17-year-old car wash attendant with a pressure washer over $2, and his company fires him. Describe the frame you'd use and the text you'd put on it, in 2–3 sentences



7. The software you use, including anything for upscaling or cleaning up blurry video frames



8. Your expected rate (per thumbnail or per month)



9. How quickly you usually deliver a thumbnail after receiving a brief, and the hours you work (Philippine time)



10. Your 
 username



Applications that skip the code word or any of items 1–9 won't be reviewed.

**AluGlobus Aluminum Systems** is a growing U.S.-based manufacturer and supplier of aluminum fencing, gates, patio covers, pergola systems, railings, and architectural aluminum products.



We are looking for a **skilled, organized, and detail-oriented Architectural Estimator** to join our team and prepare customer quotes on a daily basis.



This is not just a data-entry position. We need someone who can understand a project, review measurements, photos, drawings, and customer requests, determine what materials are needed, and build an accurate professional quote.



### Responsibilities



- Prepare detailed estimates and customer quotes every day

- Review architectural drawings, plans, measurements, photos, and project information

- Break down fence, gate, railing, patio cover, and pergola projects into the materials and components required

- Calculate quantities, dimensions, and project requirements accurately

- Use Photoshop or similar software to make basic photo edits, markups, and project visualizations

- Double-check estimates before they are sent to customers

- Learn our aluminum systems, profiles, accessories, pricing, and installation requirements

- Handle multiple quotes and projects at the same time while meeting deadlines



### Who We Are Looking For



You should be **very detail-oriented and organized**. Small mistakes in dimensions or materials can affect an entire project, so accuracy is extremely important.



Preferred experience:



- Architecture, estimating, construction, engineering, drafting, or similar background

- Experience reading construction plans and architectural drawings

- Experience preparing material takeoffs or project estimates

- Good understanding of measurements and dimensions

- Photoshop skills

- AutoCAD, SketchUp, or similar design software is a strong advantage

- Strong written and spoken English

- Comfortable speaking with U.S. customers by phone

- Strong computer skills

- Ability to learn new products and systems quickly

- Excellent attention to detail



Experience with **fencing, gates, aluminum systems, patio covers, pergolas, railings, construction, or exterior architectural products** is a major advantage.



### What Success Looks Like



You can receive a project with photos, dimensions, drawings, or plans and understand what the customer is trying to build.



You know what information is missing and are comfortable contacting the customer to get it.



You can then break the project down, calculate the required materials, and prepare a **clean, accurate, professional quote** for our sales team and customer.



We are a fast-growing company with a high volume of projects, so we are looking for someone who wants a **long-term position and an opportunity to grow with the company.**



### How to Apply

1. Your resume
