title: Experienced YouTube Shorts & Instagram Reels Video Editor — FAST Turnaround
description:
Experienced YouTube Shorts & Instagram Reels Video Editor — FAST Turnaround



Company: Skylar Racing, Inc.  

Position: Senior Short-Form Video Editor & Content Creator  

Location: Remote (Philippines)  

Job Type: Long-Term / Full-Time or Part-Time  

Compensation: Based on experience, editing quality, and production speed



## About Us



Skylar Racing is a fast-growing U.S.-based live-commerce and e-commerce company specializing in retro video games, modern gaming products, collectibles, electronics, and other merchandise.



We are actively expanding our presence on Instagram, YouTube, and other social media platforms.



We are looking for a highly experienced, extremely efficient video editor who specializes in creating professional, engaging, high-retention YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels.



We are NOT looking for a beginner. We need someone who already knows how to create excellent short-form content and can deliver high-quality edits quickly.



This is not strictly an editing position. We also need someone who can independently come up with creative, interesting, and potentially viral video ideas for our social media channels.



## What You'll Be Editing



Our content primarily consists of:



- Retro and modern video game videos

- Rare and expensive collectible showcases

- Interesting products and merchandise

- Behind-the-scenes business content

- Live auction and Whatnot highlights

- Product unboxings and demonstrations

- Educational and entertaining gaming content

- Viral-style Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts



Most videos will be approximately 15–90 seconds long.



We provide the original footage. Your responsibility is to transform that footage into engaging, polished, ready-to-post content.



You will also be responsible for recommending new video concepts that our team can film.



## Responsibilities



- Edit short-form videos specifically for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

- Create strong hooks within the first 1–3 seconds to capture attention.

- Remove unnecessary pauses, filler words, awkward moments, and dead space.

- Add clean, engaging, professionally animated subtitles.

- Incorporate appropriate zooms, transitions, motion graphics, and visual effects.

- Add sound effects and music when appropriate.

- Find and insert relevant B-roll, product images, screenshots, and other supporting visuals.

- Improve audio quality, lighting, exposure, and color consistency when necessary.

- Understand pacing, storytelling, and viewer retention.

- Make editing decisions that increase watch time and keep viewers engaged.

- Follow branding guidelines while maintaining a clean, professional appearance.

- Create content that feels natural and premium, not overly edited or artificial.

- Deliver finalized videos in 1080 × 1920 vertical format.

- Organize project files and provide revisions when necessary.

- Communicate clearly and consistently about assignments and deadlines.

- Independently research and suggest new video ideas for our channels.

- Recommend hooks, video structures, filming techniques, and content angles that could improve performance.



## Video Ideas & Content Development



In addition to editing, you must be capable of consistently generating creative video ideas.



We do not want an editor who simply waits for footage and instructions every day.



We want someone who actively contributes to the growth of our social media presence by researching trends, studying successful content, and suggesting new videos for our team to create.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Regularly researching successful Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other short-form content.

- Identifying trending video concepts that could be adapted to our gaming, collectibles, and e-commerce content.

- Developing original, interesting, and attention-grabbing video ideas.

- Providing clear concepts that explain what we should film and why viewers would find the video interesting.

- Suggesting strong opening hooks and titles for each idea.

- Recommending specific camera angles, shots, or footage needed to execute the idea.

- Identifying opportunities to turn existing footage into additional content.

- Studying competitors and successful creators to identify content opportunities.

- Recommending improvements to our existing videos based on performance and viewer engagement.

- Helping us establish a consistent pipeline of new content ideas.



We expect you to proactively contribute ideas on a regular basis rather than needing to be asked.



For example, if you notice a particular style of retro gaming video performing well on social media, you should be able to suggest how Skylar Racing could create its own original version.



Ideally, you should provide a brief description, suggested hook, filming requirements, and an explanation of why the concept could perform well.



The ability to generate strong video concepts is a requirement for this position, not an optional bonus.



## Speed Is Extremely Important



We are specifically looking for an editor who can work FAST without sacrificing quality.



Our goal is to publish content consistently, and we need someone who can keep up with a high-volume editing workflow.



You should be capable of:



- Completing straightforward short-form edits within 24 hours of receiving footage and instructions.

- Editing multiple videos per working day when footage and editing complexity allow.

- Working on multiple projects without losing organization or quality.

- Prioritizing urgent assignments and meeting agreed deadlines.

- Making requested revisions efficiently.

- Working independently without constant instructions or supervision.



We are not interested in waiting several days for a basic 30–60-second Reel.



Please be realistic about your editing speed. We will evaluate both the quality of your work and how efficiently you complete assignments.



## Required Qualifications



- At least 3 years of professional video editing experience, or an equivalent portfolio demonstrating advanced skills.

- Extensive experience editing YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or TikTok videos.

- Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or comparable professional editing software.

- Strong understanding of viral short-form content, viewer retention, and social media trends.

- Excellent caption animation and motion graphics skills.

- Ability to create visually appealing videos without excessive effects or unnecessary distractions.

- Strong storytelling skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to independently develop and pitch creative video concepts.

- Ability to research content trends and identify opportunities for original videos.

- Strong understanding of what makes someone stop scrolling and watch a video.

- Ability to find and incorporate relevant supporting images and B-roll.

- Excellent understanding of music, sound effects, audio mixing, and timing.

- Ability to work quickly while maintaining consistently high standards.

- Reliable internet access and a computer capable of handling professional editing workloads.

- Strong English comprehension and communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and follow instructions precisely.



## Preferred Skills



- Experience editing gaming, technology, collectibles, or e-commerce content.

- Experience creating viral videos with significant organic views.

- Experience developing short-form content strategies and video concepts.

- Ability to analyze why certain videos perform better than others.

- Advanced masking, tracking, and motion graphics experience.

- Experience creating Instagram Reel and YouTube Shorts thumbnails.

- Understanding of YouTube and Instagram content formatting and safe zones.

- Ability to recommend better hooks, pacing, and video structure.

- Familiarity with trends without relying on repetitive editing templates.



## Editing Style We're Looking For



We want high-quality, engaging content that looks professionally edited.



Our preferred style includes:



- Fast-paced editing when appropriate

- Attention-grabbing opening hooks

- Clean, readable subtitles

- Smooth transitions and natural visual movement

- Relevant product close-ups and B-roll

- High-quality audio and sound design

- Strong storytelling and intentional pacing

- Natural-looking colors and realistic visuals

- Professional presentation without excessive effects



We do NOT want overly flashy, chaotic, cartoonish, or obviously AI-generated-looking videos.



Every effect should serve a purpose. We value strong editing decisions over unnecessary visual clutter.



## What Success Looks Like



A successful editor will consistently:



- Deliver content on time.

- Produce professional videos with minimal revisions.

- Understand the intended style without needing repeated explanations.

- Identify and remove boring or unnecessary footage.

- Make thoughtful decisions about hooks and storytelling.

- Maintain consistent quality across multiple videos.

- Proactively supply creative and actionable video ideas.

- Research trends and identify potential content opportunities.

- Suggest improvements based on actual video performance.

- Help us increase our output of high-quality short-form content.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Portfolio



Provide links to at least 3–5 short-form videos you personally edited. We strongly prefer YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels rather than traditional long-form videos.



2. Experience



How many years have you been professionally editing videos? Which editing programs do you use most frequently?



3. Editing Speed



Approximately how long does it take you to complete a polished 30–60-second Instagram Reel when provided with raw talking-head footage?



4. Daily Production Capacity



How many professional-quality Shorts or Reels could you realistically complete during an 8-hour working day?



5. Previous Results



Have any videos you edited achieved 100,000, 500,000, or 1,000,000+ views? If so, provide examples and explain your specific role in editing them.



6. Video Ideas & Creativity



In addition to editing, you will be expected to regularly come up with new video ideas. Describe your experience developing content concepts, researching trends, and suggesting videos for social media channels.



7. Creative Test



Provide 3 original YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels ideas that you believe would perform well for a company that sells retro video games, modern gaming products, and rare collectibles.



For each idea, briefly explain the concept, the opening hook, and what footage we would need to film.



8. Compensation



What is your expected monthly salary for full-time work, or your hourly/project rate for part-time work?



9. Availability



What hours are you typically available to work, and how soon could you begin?



## Selection Process



Qualified applicants may be asked to complete a short, paid editing test using footage provided by our company.



The purpose is to evaluate:



- Editing quality

- Creative decisions

- Hook development

- Caption quality

- Sound design

- Attention to detail

- Turnaround time

- Ability to follow instructions

- Ability to generate original and engaging video ideas



Applicants who demonstrate exceptional editing quality, speed, and creativity will receive priority consideration.



IMPORTANT: To confirm you have read this entire job posting, begin your application with the words "SKYLAR EDITOR" before answering the questions above.



We are seeking a reliable, talented, and creative editor interested in developing a long-term working relationship with our company.

title: Gaming Product Sourcing Specialist / Online Inventory Researcher
description:
Gaming Product Sourcing Specialist / Online Inventory Researcher



Company: Skylar Racing, Inc.  

Position: Gaming Product Sourcing Specialist / Online Researcher  

Location: Remote (Philippines)  

Job Type: Long-Term / Full-Time or Part-Time  

Compensation: Based on experience, research abilities, and performance



## About Us



Skylar Racing is a U.S.-based live-commerce business specializing in retro video games, modern gaming products, consoles, collectibles, electronics, and other merchandise.



We sell a large volume of products through live auctions on Whatnot and are constantly looking for new inventory to purchase and resell.



We are looking for an extremely internet-savvy, knowledgeable, and motivated individual who can research products, discover profitable inventory opportunities, and provide purchasing recommendations to our team on a daily basis.



This position is primarily focused on video games and gaming-related merchandise, but we are also interested in products that would appeal to gamers, collectors, and our live auction audience.



You must already have a strong understanding of video games, gaming consoles, accessories, gaming collectibles, and online shopping marketplaces.



We are NOT looking for someone who needs to learn what a Nintendo DS, PlayStation Vita, GameCube, or Game Boy Advance is.



We want someone who genuinely understands the gaming industry, enjoys researching products online, and knows how to find interesting merchandise at competitive prices.



## Primary Responsibilities



Your primary responsibility will be to search the internet every working day for products and inventory opportunities that Skylar Racing could purchase and resell through live auctions.



You will spend a significant portion of your day researching websites, comparing prices, identifying suppliers, and sending direct purchasing links to our team.



Responsibilities include:



- Search eBay daily for video game lots, consoles, handhelds, accessories, collectibles, and profitable inventory.

- Research liquidation websites for gaming-related inventory, overstock products, customer returns, and closeout merchandise.

- Search Alibaba for manufacturers, wholesalers, and products suitable for resale.

- Identify gaming accessories and products that could be purchased in bulk and sold individually.

- Discover interesting, unusual, or trending products that would appeal to gamers.

- Compare purchasing prices against realistic resale values.

- Research recent eBay sold listings and other relevant market data.

- Identify bulk deals, undervalued listings, and potential wholesale opportunities.

- Find suppliers offering large quantities of identical products at attractive prices.

- Research international and domestic sourcing opportunities.

- Identify products that could work particularly well in a fast-paced live auction environment.

- Send direct links to potential inventory purchases to our team every working day.

- Maintain an organized daily list of sourcing opportunities in Google Sheets.

- Monitor previously discovered products for price changes, restocks, and new availability.

- Immediately communicate particularly valuable or time-sensitive purchasing opportunities.

- Continuously discover new websites and suppliers rather than relying on the same few sources.



You will not be responsible for purchasing inventory without authorization. Your role is to research opportunities and provide accurate, organized recommendations.



## Daily Product Links & Purchasing Recommendations



This is one of the most important responsibilities of the position.



We expect you to actively search for new inventory opportunities and send links to products that our company could realistically purchase every single scheduled working day.



You should not wait for management to ask you to find products.



Your daily responsibilities will include:



- Continuously searching eBay, Alibaba, liquidation websites, wholesalers, and other marketplaces.

- Sending links to potential purchases throughout your working shift.

- Providing accurate purchase prices, quantities, condition details, and relevant information.

- Explaining why you believe each product is worth considering.

- Identifying opportunities where the purchase price is significantly below realistic resale value.

- Finding products that can be purchased in bulk at attractive prices.

- Locating merchandise that would appeal to our existing gaming and collector audience.

- Keeping an organized list of all potential purchases.

- Ensuring links are active and products are still available when submitted.

- Avoiding duplicate recommendations unless pricing or availability has materially changed.

- Providing a daily summary of the strongest purchasing opportunities discovered.



We expect a consistent flow of new purchasing opportunities.



Our initial target is approximately 10–20 qualified product leads per full working day, depending on the complexity of the research. Quality is more important than volume, and this target may be adjusted as we evaluate the usefulness of your recommendations.



We are not looking for someone who sends random eBay listings or overpriced retail products just to meet a daily quota.



Every submitted link should represent a genuine potential purchasing opportunity supported by research.



If you discover an unusually good deal that could sell out quickly, we expect you to communicate that opportunity immediately rather than waiting until the end of your shift.



At the end of each working day, our purchasing team should have a clear list of new products, suppliers, and potential purchases to review.



Consistently providing useful purchasing links is a core performance expectation for this role.



## Gaming Knowledge Is Required



We are specifically looking for someone who already understands video games and gaming-related merchandise.



You should be familiar with:



- Nintendo handhelds, including Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, Nintendo DS, Nintendo 3DS, and related models.

- Sony consoles and handhelds, including PlayStation, PSP, PS Vita, and related accessories.

- Nintendo consoles such as Nintendo 64, GameCube, Wii, Wii U, Nintendo Switch, and newer systems.

- Xbox consoles, controllers, and accessories.

- Retro and modern video game cartridges and discs.

- Console controllers, replacement accessories, adapters, cables, and peripherals.

- Special edition gaming consoles and collectible merchandise.

- Japanese video games, imported consoles, and gaming accessories.

- Console repair tools, replacement parts, and maintenance accessories.

- Gaming-related electronics, gadgets, and collectibles.



You do not need to know the value of every item, but you should have enough gaming knowledge to recognize interesting products, identify potential deals, and research unfamiliar items efficiently.



A strong understanding of Japanese gaming products and retro gaming is particularly valuable.



## Products We Want You to Find



Although gaming is our primary focus, we sell many different types of merchandise.



We are interested in sourcing:



- Retro video games, consoles, and handhelds

- Modern gaming consoles and accessories

- Gaming controllers and replacement parts

- Gaming repair tools and electronics accessories

- Gaming collectibles, figures, and novelty products

- Gaming-themed merchandise and desk accessories

- Gaming room decorations and display products

- Interesting technology products and gadgets

- Unique electronics and useful everyday accessories

- Bulk liquidation and closeout products

- Products that can be purchased cheaply in large quantities

- Unique merchandise that gamers and collectors would be excited to purchase



For example, finding a manufacturer offering an interesting gaming accessory for $2 per unit could be valuable if the product has realistic resale demand and attractive margins.



Finding a bulk lot of retro video games on eBay at a significantly lower price than their realistic resale value could also be valuable.



We are especially interested in unique products, good deals, large quantities, and merchandise that would create excitement during our live auctions.



## Websites & Marketplaces



You should already be comfortable navigating online marketplaces and conducting extensive internet research.



Websites you may regularly use include:



- eBay

- Alibaba

- AliExpress

- Major liquidation and closeout websites

- Wholesale inventory marketplaces

- Manufacturer and distributor websites

- Japanese gaming marketplaces

- International wholesale suppliers

- Specialty retro gaming websites

- Online auction websites

- Other product sourcing and wholesale platforms



You should be able to discover additional sourcing websites independently.



We do not want someone who only knows how to perform basic Google searches.



We want someone who knows how to use search filters, advanced search terms, sold listing history, image searches, marketplace categories, and other research tools to uncover opportunities that may not be immediately obvious.



## Understanding Live Auction Sales



Our company sells merchandise through live auctions, primarily on Whatnot.



Understanding this business model is extremely important.



The products we purchase are not necessarily the same products that traditional online retailers would prioritize.



You should understand that:



- Some products sell quickly because they are recognizable and desirable.

- Interesting products can perform well even if they are inexpensive.

- Bulk quantities can be more valuable to us than a single profitable item.

- A product's perceived value and actual demand both matter.

- Live auction prices may differ significantly from traditional eBay listing prices.

- Purchasing cost, shipping, platform fees, defects, and other expenses affect profitability.

- The ability to repeatedly source a successful product can be extremely valuable.



Experience buying or selling on Whatnot is highly preferred.



At a minimum, you should familiarize yourself with how Whatnot live auctions operate, including how streamers present products and how customers bid.



## Product Research & Profitability



We expect you to evaluate potential purchasing opportunities rather than simply forwarding links.



When recommending a product, you should be able to provide:



1. Product name and description.

2. Direct link to the listing or supplier.

3. Purchase price and currency.

4. Available quantity or minimum order quantity.

5. Estimated shipping costs when available.

6. Relevant product condition information.

7. Recent comparable sold prices or other supporting market data.

8. Estimated resale price or realistic resale range.

9. Potential profitability, accounting for known expenses.

10. A short explanation of why the product could sell well during our live auctions.



You are not expected to know every expense perfectly, but you should identify uncertainties and avoid presenting unsupported resale estimates as guaranteed profits.



We value accurate research far more than exaggerated profit projections.



## Alibaba & Wholesale Sourcing



Alibaba sourcing will also be an important part of this position.



You should be comfortable:



- Searching Alibaba for gaming accessories and unique products.

- Comparing multiple manufacturers offering similar products.

- Identifying suppliers with competitive pricing.

- Reviewing minimum order quantities.

- Understanding basic product customization and private-label opportunities.

- Comparing product quality, specifications, and supplier information.

- Identifying inexpensive products with strong potential resale demand.

- Researching products that could complement our existing merchandise.

- Finding accessories that we could eventually sell under our own brand.

- Understanding that sample costs, international shipping, duties, and product quality affect overall cost.



Previous experience with Alibaba or international product sourcing is highly preferred.



You must also be able to recognize potential counterfeit, trademark, copyright, safety, or compliance concerns and flag those products rather than recommending them for purchase without further review.



## Internet Research Skills



This position requires excellent internet research skills.



You should be capable of navigating websites quickly, opening and comparing multiple listings, using advanced search filters, and organizing large amounts of product information.



You should know how to:



- Search efficiently across many websites.

- Use advanced keywords and search operators.

- Find alternative suppliers for a specific product.

- Use Google Lens or reverse image searches to identify products.

- Compare listings for the same or similar merchandise.

- Identify suspicious or unreliable sellers.

- Find historical sold prices rather than relying solely on asking prices.

- Research products using Japanese or other international websites when necessary.

- Use translation tools to navigate foreign-language listings.

- Identify listings that are duplicates or no longer available.

- Organize research efficiently using Google Sheets.



We are looking for someone who is genuinely skilled at navigating the internet and discovering information independently.



## Speed, Productivity & Organization



Efficiency is extremely important.



We need someone who can research products quickly, identify worthwhile opportunities, and avoid spending excessive amounts of time on unpromising listings.



You should be able to:



- Work efficiently across multiple browser tabs and websites.

- Research multiple product categories during a working day.

- Send new potential purchasing links consistently throughout each shift.

- Maintain an organized record of potential purchases.

- Prioritize opportunities based on estimated profitability and availability.

- Immediately communicate unusually strong or time-sensitive deals.

- Avoid repeatedly submitting the same listings.

- Distinguish high-quality opportunities from ordinary retail listings.

- Consistently produce useful research without needing constant supervision.



Our priority is quality purchasing opportunities, not simply the number of links submitted.



Submitting 10 excellent opportunities is more valuable than submitting 100 random products that would not be profitable.



## Required Qualifications



- Strong existing knowledge of retro and modern video games.

- Excellent internet research and online marketplace navigation skills.

- Familiarity with eBay and online shopping platforms.

- Ability to identify gaming products, accessories, and collectibles.

- Understanding of product pricing and resale value research.

- Familiarity with wholesale and liquidation sourcing.

- Ability to compare listings and identify attractive purchasing opportunities.

- Ability to consistently research and submit potential purchasing links every working day.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Excellent organizational skills.

- Proficiency with Google Sheets.

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and meet daily expectations.

- Reliable internet connection and computer.

- Willingness to learn new sourcing websites and research methods.

- Ability to accurately document product links, pricing, quantities, and other relevant information.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience using Whatnot as a buyer or seller.

- Previous experience sourcing products for e-commerce or resale businesses.

- Experience purchasing or researching video game lots on eBay.

- Experience sourcing products through Alibaba.

- Familiarity with Japanese gaming marketplaces.

- Knowledge of gaming merchandise resale values.

- Experience with liquidation or wholesale product sourcing.

- Understanding of profit margins and inventory purchasing.

- Experience finding clearance, closeout, or bulk inventory deals.

- Familiarity with Google Lens, reverse image searches, and advanced online research.



## What Success Looks Like



A successful employee will:



- Send a consistent stream of qualified purchasing links every scheduled working day.

- Consistently discover products we would realistically consider purchasing.

- Find inventory at prices that allow for attractive resale margins.

- Identify gaming products and accessories with strong customer appeal.

- Discover suppliers or products our team has not previously considered.

- Provide accurate and well-organized research.

- Find useful wholesale and bulk purchasing opportunities.

- Quickly communicate worthwhile deals before they disappear.

- Develop a strong understanding of the types of products that perform well in our live auctions.

- Improve the quality of their purchasing recommendations over time.

- Produce daily sourcing reports that give management actionable opportunities to review.



We are looking for someone who takes initiative and genuinely enjoys the process of hunting for profitable products online.



## How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application.



1. Gaming Knowledge



How familiar are you with retro and modern video games? Which gaming consoles, handhelds, accessories, and collectibles do you have the most knowledge about? Please be specific.



2. Previous Sourcing Experience



Have you previously sourced products for resale, researched wholesale inventory, or found deals on eBay, Alibaba, or liquidation websites? Explain your experience and which websites you have used.



3. Internet Research Skills



Describe your process for finding an underpriced product online. Which websites, search tools, browser extensions, or research methods would you use to determine whether it is a good deal?



4. Live Selling Knowledge



Are you familiar with Whatnot or other live auction platforms? Have you purchased or sold anything through live auctions? What do you think makes a product successful in this selling environment?



5. Alibaba Experience



Have you used Alibaba to research manufacturers or wholesale products? If so, describe your experience comparing suppliers, pricing, minimum order quantities, and product specifications.



6. Daily Research Productivity



This position requires sending potential purchasing links to our team every working day. How would you organize your daily research to consistently discover worthwhile opportunities? Approximately how many properly researched product recommendations do you believe you could provide during an 8-hour shift?



7. Practical Research Question



Imagine we want to purchase 100 inexpensive gaming-related accessories that could be sold individually during live auctions.



Where would you look for these products, how would you evaluate them, and what information would you provide before recommending a purchase?



8. Work Availability



What is your daily availability, Monday through Sunday? Are you looking for full-time or part-time employment, and how soon could you begin?



9. Compensation



What is your expected monthly salary in PHP for full-time employment, or your hourly rate for part-time employment?



## Application Test



To demonstrate your research ability, include 3 actual products you discovered online that you believe could be profitable for our business.



At least 2 products should be gaming-related.



For each product, include:



- Product name

- Direct purchasing link

- Current purchase price

- Available quantity, if shown

- Estimated resale price and supporting evidence

- Brief explanation of why you believe it would be a good product for our live auctions



Please do not submit random popular products without considering their potential profitability.



Qualified applicants may be invited to complete an additional paid research assignment.



## Selection Process



We will evaluate applicants based on:



- Gaming knowledge

- Familiarity with online marketplaces

- Research speed and efficiency

- Quality of product sourcing recommendations

- Ability to consistently provide useful daily purchasing links

- Understanding of resale value and profitability

- Ability to identify unique inventory opportunities

- Organizational and communication skills

- Independent problem-solving ability



Previous sourcing experience is valuable, but exceptional gaming knowledge and outstanding internet research skills are equally important.



IMPORTANT: To confirm you have read the full job description, begin your application with the words "SKYLAR SOURCING" before answering the questions above.



We are seeking a reliable, knowledgeable, and highly motivated individual interested in building a long-term working relationship with Skylar Racing.

title: E-Commerce Customer Support & Order Resolution Specialist
description:
# E-Commerce Customer Support & Order Resolution Specialist



Company: Skylar Racing, Inc.  

Position: E-Commerce Customer Support Specialist  

Location: Remote (Philippines)  

Job Type: Long-Term / Full-Time or Part-Time  

Compensation: Based on experience and qualifications



## About Us



Skylar Racing is a U.S.-based live-commerce and e-commerce company specializing in video games, collectibles, electronics, and a wide variety of other merchandise.



We sell a large volume of products through live auctions on Whatnot and other online marketplaces, including eBay and Shopify.



With a large number of orders and customer interactions, providing excellent customer service is an extremely important part of our business.



We are looking for a highly organized, dependable, and experienced Customer Support Specialist who can manage customer inquiries, investigate order issues, resolve routine problems, and ensure customers receive timely, professional assistance.



This position requires someone who is comfortable working independently, communicating with customers in English, navigating e-commerce platforms, and managing multiple customer issues simultaneously.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply sends generic, copied responses to every customer.



We need someone who can understand an issue, investigate the situation, communicate professionally, and work toward a proper resolution.



## Primary Responsibilities



Your primary responsibility will be to manage customer support inquiries across our selling platforms and help resolve order-related issues efficiently.



You will be expected to monitor customer messages throughout your scheduled working hours and take ownership of assigned support cases until they are resolved or appropriately escalated.



Responsibilities include:



- Responding to customer messages on Whatnot, eBay, Shopify, and other company-approved channels.

- Answering questions regarding orders, shipping, delivery status, and product information.

- Investigating missing, delayed, damaged, or incorrect orders.

- Researching shipment tracking information through USPS, UPS, FedEx, and other carriers.

- Helping customers understand shipping timelines and tracking updates.

- Reviewing customer complaints and determining the appropriate next steps.

- Handling routine refund, return, cancellation, and replacement requests within company policies and assigned authority.

- Escalating refund approvals, disputes, or unusual cases to management when necessary.

- Communicating with our warehouse and shipping departments to investigate order issues.

- Maintaining detailed records of customer conversations and actions taken.

- Following up on unresolved customer complaints until a resolution is reached.

- Identifying recurring customer service problems and reporting them to management.

- Maintaining a professional, friendly, and helpful tone in all interactions.

- Protecting customer information and following company privacy and security procedures.



## Daily Customer Support Responsibilities



You will be expected to actively manage customer support responsibilities every scheduled working day.



We want someone who takes initiative and does not wait for management to remind them to check messages or follow up on existing cases.



Your daily responsibilities will include:



- Reviewing all new customer messages at the beginning of your shift.

- Responding promptly to customer inquiries during scheduled working hours.

- Reviewing outstanding cases from previous shifts.

- Checking tracking information for orders with reported delivery issues.

- Investigating customer complaints using available order details and records.

- Communicating with customers regarding the status of their inquiries.

- Following up with warehouse personnel when physical order verification is needed.

- Identifying urgent issues that require management attention.

- Maintaining an organized record of pending, escalated, and resolved support cases.

- Providing an end-of-shift summary of unresolved issues and any actions needed from management.



Our goal is to maintain an organized customer support process where messages are not overlooked and problems are addressed as efficiently as possible.



## Whatnot Customer Support



A significant portion of this position will involve supporting customers who purchase products during our Whatnot live auctions.



Experience with Whatnot is highly preferred.



You should be able to learn and understand:



- How Whatnot live auctions and purchases work.

- How buyers view their orders and tracking information.

- How to locate relevant order details.

- How to investigate shipping and fulfillment complaints.

- How to respond to product condition concerns.

- How to handle customers reporting missing or incorrect merchandise.

- How to recognize issues that require Whatnot platform support or management involvement.

- How to communicate with customers who purchased multiple products during a livestream.

- How to follow platform policies regarding orders, cancellations, refunds, and disputes.



Because customers purchase products during fast-paced live auctions, some inquiries may involve multiple items, order bundles, product condition disagreements, or confusion about what was purchased.



You must be able to investigate these situations carefully rather than making assumptions.



Accuracy is extremely important.



## Shipping, Tracking & Delivery Issues



A major part of this position will involve resolving shipping-related inquiries.



You should be comfortable reviewing shipment tracking records and explaining carrier updates to customers.



Examples of common situations include:



- A customer says their order has not arrived.

- Tracking has not updated for several days.

- A package is marked delivered, but the customer cannot locate it.

- A customer received the wrong item.

- One or more items are missing from a shipment.

- A package arrived damaged.

- An order has not shipped within the expected timeframe.

- A customer is confused about combined or multiple shipments.

- A shipment has been returned to sender.

- A buyer wants an update on an existing support case.



You should be able to investigate the available information, determine the appropriate next steps, and communicate clearly with the customer.



You must never guarantee a delivery date or promise a refund or replacement without supporting information and appropriate authorization.



## Refunds, Returns & Customer Complaints



You will help manage customer complaints related to refunds, returns, cancellations, and order discrepancies.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Reviewing customer complaints carefully.

- Locating the relevant order information.

- Requesting appropriate supporting details when necessary.

- Identifying whether a request falls within company and platform policies.

- Preparing cases for management approval when required.

- Responding to customers with accurate and professional information.

- Tracking unresolved refund or return cases.

- Following up on cases awaiting warehouse confirmation or management decisions.

- Documenting the final resolution.



You will not have independent authority to issue refunds, cancel orders, offer compensation, or make financial commitments unless explicitly authorized by management.



Our goal is to resolve legitimate customer problems fairly and efficiently while protecting the company from unnecessary losses and preventable mistakes.



## Customer Communication & English Skills



Excellent written English is a requirement for this position.



You will be representing our company when speaking directly with customers, so your messages must be clear, natural, professional, and easy to understand.



We are looking for someone who can:



- Write grammatically correct English.

- Understand customer concerns without requiring repeated explanations.

- Communicate naturally rather than relying entirely on templates.

- Remain polite and professional when customers are frustrated.

- Explain complicated situations using simple, understandable language.

- Recognize when a customer needs additional assistance.

- Ask relevant questions to gather missing information.

- Avoid argumentative, defensive, or disrespectful responses.

- Communicate with management when an issue requires escalation.



You must be comfortable communicating with U.S.-based customers and coworkers.



AI tools may be used when authorized to assist with drafting, but you must independently verify all information and ensure messages accurately address the customer's situation.



## Problem-Solving & Independent Work



We are looking for someone who can investigate problems and take appropriate action without requiring constant guidance.



For example, if a customer contacts us because their package is missing, we do not want someone who simply forwards the message to management without investigating.



We want someone who first reviews the tracking information, checks available order records, determines the likely issue, and identifies the next appropriate step.



Strong candidates will demonstrate:



- Independent problem-solving.

- Attention to detail.

- Good judgment.

- Strong organizational skills.

- Ability to prioritize urgent customer concerns.

- Accountability for assigned cases.

- Willingness to learn new platforms and procedures.

- Ability to recognize situations requiring management approval.



You should be able to handle routine issues independently while knowing when escalation is necessary.



## Customer Support Organization & Reporting



You will be responsible for keeping customer support information organized and accessible.



Depending on company procedures, this may involve Google Sheets, shared documents, platform messaging systems, or customer support software.



You should be comfortable maintaining information such as:



- Customer name or platform username.

- Order number.

- Selling platform.

- Date the issue was reported.

- Description of the problem.

- Actions already taken.

- Current case status.

- Required follow-up.

- Date of resolution.



We expect a daily report that summarizes:



- Number of new customer inquiries.

- Number of inquiries responded to.

- Number of cases resolved.

- Number of outstanding cases.

- Urgent issues needing management attention.

- Common customer complaints or recurring problems.



You should also be capable of identifying patterns that could help us improve shipping, order accuracy, product descriptions, or fulfillment procedures.



## Work Schedule & Availability



We are looking for someone who can maintain a reliable and consistent work schedule.



Because our business and customers are primarily located in the United States, the ability to work scheduled hours that overlap with U.S. business operations is highly desirable.



You should be comfortable:



- Maintaining a consistent schedule each week.

- Communicating with U.S.-based management.

- Responding to assigned customer inquiries during scheduled shifts.

- Attending occasional virtual meetings or training sessions.

- Providing advance notice of scheduling conflicts.

- Managing your responsibilities without constant supervision.



Please include your daily availability when applying.



## Required Qualifications



- Previous experience in customer service, preferably in an e-commerce environment.

- Excellent written English communication skills.

- Familiarity with online shopping platforms and customer order processes.

- Experience handling customer complaints and resolving problems.

- Strong internet research and computer navigation skills.

- Ability to investigate shipping and tracking issues.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- Ability to manage several customer conversations and support cases simultaneously.

- Ability to work independently and follow company procedures.

- Professional and courteous communication style.

- Reliable internet connection and computer.

- Ability to maintain accurate records using Google Sheets or similar tools.

- Willingness to learn Whatnot, eBay, Shopify, and other company platforms.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Previous Whatnot customer support experience.

- Experience with eBay seller support or customer service.

- Shopify order management experience.

- Experience handling a high volume of e-commerce orders.

- Experience with shipping investigations and delivery disputes.

- Familiarity with USPS, UPS, and FedEx tracking systems.

- Experience handling returns, refunds, and damaged merchandise inquiries.

- Experience with customer support ticketing systems.

- Experience working with U.S.-based e-commerce companies.

- Familiarity with video games, collectibles, electronics, or similar merchandise.



Knowledge of video games is helpful but is not required for this position.



## Performance Expectations



A successful employee will consistently:



- Respond to customer messages promptly during scheduled working hours.

- Keep outstanding cases organized and updated.

- Resolve routine issues without unnecessary management involvement.

- Escalate urgent or complicated cases appropriately.

- Communicate professionally and accurately.

- Follow up on unresolved customer complaints.

- Maintain thorough and accurate documentation.

- Avoid making unauthorized promises or financial commitments.

- Help reduce the number of customer issues requiring direct management attention.

- Identify recurring problems and suggest improvements.

- Maintain consistent attendance and reliability.



Performance will be evaluated based on response times, case accuracy, quality of resolutions, customer communication, productivity, and adherence to company procedures.



We prioritize correct resolutions and customer satisfaction over simply closing cases as quickly as possible.



## How to Apply



Please answer all of the following questions.



1. Customer Service Experience



Describe your previous customer service experience. Which companies or industries have you worked in, what types of customer inquiries did you handle, and approximately how many customers or support cases did you manage per day?



2. E-Commerce Experience



Have you previously worked with Whatnot, eBay, Shopify, Amazon, or other online selling platforms? Explain which platforms you used and what responsibilities you handled.



3. Handling Difficult Customers



Describe a situation where you had to deal with an angry or frustrated customer. What was the problem, how did you respond, and what was the final outcome?



4. Missing Package Scenario



A customer contacts us saying their $150 order has not arrived. The tracking information shows the package was delivered two days ago. Explain exactly how you would investigate the situation and what you would communicate to the customer.



5. Customer Response Test



A customer sends the following message:



"I ordered three video games from your Whatnot stream and only received two. This is ridiculous. I've been waiting over a week and nobody is helping me. I want my money back."



Write the exact response you would send to this customer as a customer support representative.



6. Workload & Organization



Imagine you begin your shift with 40 unread customer messages, 15 unresolved cases from the previous day, and several customers requesting urgent updates. How would you prioritize and organize your workload?



7. Independent Problem-Solving



Describe a time you successfully resolved a complicated customer issue without requiring significant assistance from a supervisor. What steps did you take?



8. English Communication



How comfortable are you communicating with customers in written English? Have you previously provided written customer support for customers located in the United States?



9. Availability



What is your availability Monday through Sunday? Are you willing to work scheduled hours that overlap with U.S. Eastern Time? Are you looking for full-time or part-time employment?



10. Compensation



What is your expected monthly salary in PHP for full-time employment, or hourly rate for part-time employment?



## Selection Process



Qualified applicants may be invited to complete a short, paid customer support assessment.



The assessment may include:



- Responding to simulated customer complaints.

- Investigating a sample shipping issue.

- Organizing a small group of support cases.

- Identifying which situations require management approval.

- Drafting professional responses to difficult customer messages.



We will evaluate candidates based on written English, problem-solving ability, customer service experience, accuracy, professionalism, and efficiency.



IMPORTANT: To confirm you have read the entire job posting, begin your application with the words "SKYLAR SUPPORT" before answering the questions above.



We are looking for a reliable, organized, and experienced individual interested in building a long-term working relationship with Skylar Racing.

title: Amazon PPC Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Amazon PPC Specialist to manage and optimize advertising campaigns across multiple Amazon accounts.



This is a client-facing role, so the ideal candidate should be comfortable presenting performance updates, explaining strategy, answering client questions, and communicating recommendations clearly.



You will be responsible for day-to-day campaign management, performance analysis, keyword and targeting expansion, and identifying opportunities to improve sales and advertising efficiency. You will work closely with the Amazon Advertising Lead to execute account strategies and ensure campaigns are consistently optimized toward client goals.



Key Responsibilities

* Manage and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display.

* Perform regular campaign audits and identify opportunities for optimization and expansion.

* Conduct keyword, search term, competitor, and ASIN targeting research.

* Build and manage brand, non-brand, product targeting, category targeting, and defensive campaigns.

* Monitor and optimize bids, budgets, placements, keywords, and product targets.

* Analyze performance across campaign, keyword, search term, and ASIN levels.

* Track key metrics including Spend, Sales, ACOS, ROAS, TACOS, CTR, CPC, CVR, and Orders.

* Identify high-performing search terms and opportunities for campaign expansion.

* Identify inefficient campaigns and targets and take appropriate optimization actions.

* Monitor budget utilization and ensure spend is aligned with account goals.

* Identify PPC opportunities that can support organic ranking and overall sales growth.

* Consider inventory, pricing, conversion rate, and other factors when analyzing advertising performance.

* Prepare and support weekly and monthly performance reporting.

* Join client calls and present campaign performance, insights, and next steps.

* Explain advertising strategy and performance in a clear and concise way.

* Respond to client questions and provide data-backed recommendations.

* Use AI tools and PPC management software to support analysis, reporting, campaign, optimization, research, and workflow efficiency.

* Clearly document optimizations, findings, tests, and recommended next steps.

* Stay current with Amazon Ads updates and advertising best practices.



Requirements

* At least 5+ years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience.

* Strong experience managing Amazon advertising accounts.

* Strong understanding of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display.

* Strong understanding of keyword targeting, product targeting, match types, search term harvesting, negatives, placements, bids, and budget management.

* Comfortable analyzing advertising data using Excel or Google Sheets.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Ability to diagnose changes in sales and advertising performance and determine potential causes.

* Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities independently.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

* Comfortable speaking directly with clients and presenting performance updates and recommendations.

* Ability to communicate complex advertising topics in a simple, business-focused way.

* Comfortable using AI tools, automation, and PPC management software as part of day-to-day campaign management.

* Willingness to learn and adapt to new tools, platforms, and workflows.



Preferred Experience

* Strong Amazon PPC experience

* Amazon DSP experience is a plus



Performance KPIs

Performance will be evaluated across account results, execution quality, client management, and strategic contribution.

1. Account Performance

* Maintain PPC performance within the agreed client targets for ACoS, ROAS, TACoS, sales growth or profitability.

* Identify declining performance early and take corrective action.

* Improve efficiency or scale spend where opportunities exist.

* Maintain appropriate budget pacing throughout the month.

* Reduce unnecessary spend and continuously identify opportunities to improve campaign performance.



Target: Managed accounts meeting or progressing toward their agreed advertising objectives each month.



2. Optimization & Execution

* Complete scheduled account optimizations consistently and on time.

* Maintain clean campaign structures and accurate naming conventions.

* Regularly review search terms, keywords, ASIN targets, bids, placements, negatives, and budgets.

* Launch approved campaigns and tests within agreed timelines.

* Ensure campaign changes are properly documented.



Target: Planned optimizations and campaign tasks completed by deadline, with minimal execution errors.



3. Proactive Growth & Testing

* Identify new keyword, product targeting, category targeting, and campaign opportunities.

* Recommend and execute structured tests based on account performance.

* Surface opportunities to scale successful campaigns or products.

* Use PPC data to support broader recommendations around conversion, ranking, inventory, pricing, or listing performance.



Target: At least 2 meaningful growth or optimization recommendations per account per month, where applicable.



4. Client Communication

* Come prepared to client meetings with clear performance insights and recommended next steps.

* Communicate account changes and issues proactively.

* Respond to client questions accurately and professionally.

* Explain advertising performance in a way that is easy for clients to understand.



Target: Client deliverables completed on time, with no recurring communication or preparedness issues.



5. Reporting & Analysis

* Deliver accurate weekly and monthly reporting.

* Go beyond reporting metrics by explaining what changed, why it changed, and what should happen next.

* Ensure reporting data is accurate and aligned with Amazon Ads and account performance.



Target: 100% of reports delivered by deadline with accurate data



6. AI & Tool Adoption

* Effectively use approved AI tools, automation, and PPC management software to improve efficiency.

* Look for opportunities to automate repetitive work without compromising accuracy.

* Adopt new tools and workflows introduced by the team.



Target: Consistent use of approved tools and demonstrated improvement in workflow efficiency.



What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who can think beyond simply adjusting bids.



You should be able to look at an account and determine:

* Where there are opportunities to grow sales.

* Which keywords or targets should be expanded.

* Where advertising budget is being wasted.

* Which products should receive more advertising support.

* Why sales, conversion, or advertising performance changed.

* Whether performance issues are related to PPC, inventory, pricing, conversion, or other factors.

* What actions should be taken next.

* Where AI, automation, or PPC management tools can help improve efficiency and decision-making.



You should be comfortable managing campaigns independently, making data-backed recommendations, and confidently discussing those recommendations directly with clients.



Success in This Role

Success means consistently delivering against client advertising objectives, maintaining strong execution standards, proactively identifying growth opportunities, communicating clearly with clients, and managing accounts with minimal supervision.

title: TikTok Account Executive
description:
The Role

We are seeking a strategic, client-focused TikTok Account Executive to manage a portfolio of TikTok Shop brands and drive measurable business growth. This role serves as the primary point of contact for clients while collaborating closely with our Philippines-based Creator Management, Operations, Creative, and Support teams to deliver exceptional results.



Position Summary

The TikTok Account Executive is responsible for the overall success and growth of an assigned portfolio of TikTok Shop clients. This role owns client relationships, develops account growth strategies, monitors business performance, and coordinates cross-functional teams to execute affiliate, creator, and campaign initiatives that drive GMV growth.



The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills, a passion for e-commerce, and the ability to manage multiple client relationships while delivering measurable business results.



Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned TikTok Shop clients.

* Build trusted relationships through proactive communication and strategic guidance.

* Lead weekly business reviews and monthly performance meetings.

* Understand each client’s business objectives and develop customized growth strategies.

* Manage client expectations while ensuring timely follow-up and issue resolution.



Growth Strategy & Account Management

* Own the GMV performance of assigned client portfolios.

* Develop strategies to increase sales through affiliate marketing, creator activations, livestreams, promotions, and product launches.

* Identify growth opportunities and recommend optimization strategies.

* Monitor account health and proactively adjust strategies to maximize performance.

* Forecast monthly GMV performance and communicate progress against goals.



Campaign & Cross-Functional Execution

* Partner with Creator Managers, Operations, Creative, and Support teams to execute client initiatives.

* Coordinate affiliate campaigns, promotional events, creator activations, and product launches.

* Ensure projects are delivered accurately and on schedule.

* Escalate and resolve operational issues while maintaining a high level of client satisfaction.



Performance Reporting & Optimization

* Analyze account performance using TikTok Shop analytics and other reporting tools.

* Prepare weekly and monthly client reports highlighting GMV, traffic, conversion, affiliate performance, and key growth metrics.

* Present actionable recommendations based on performance data.

* Stay current on TikTok Shop updates, platform trends, and best practices to continuously improve client results.



Qualifications

Required

* 3+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, E-commerce, Digital Marketing, or Client Services.

* Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.

* Strong understanding of TikTok Shop, influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, or social commerce.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

* Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.

* Ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

Preferred

* Experience with ClickUp, 
, Asana, or similar project management platforms.

* Experience using ChatGPT and AI productivity tools.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achieve 100% or greater of assigned monthly and quarterly GMV targets across the client portfolio.

* Deliver consistent month-over-month GMV growth for assigned accounts.

* Maintain a client retention rate of 95% or higher.

* Ensure 100% on-time delivery of client reports, campaign launches, and business reviews.

* Increase affiliate and creator participation while improving overall account performance.

* Maintain excellent client satisfaction through proactive communication and strategic partnership.

* Deliver accurate forecasting and identify new revenue opportunities for assigned brands.



Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will:

* Successfully onboard and manage an assigned portfolio of TikTok Shop clients.

* Build strong relationships with clients and internal cross-functional teams.

* Consistently deliver strategic recommendations supported by performance data.

* Achieve or exceed assigned portfolio GMV goals.

* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and proactive communication.

* Become a trusted strategic advisor who contributes directly to client growth and long-term business success.



Work Location / Setup

* Remote

title: Marketplace Content & Creative Strategist
description:
Who We Are



Evo Tech Software Solutions Inc. is a highly motivated team of professionals based in Cebu, Philippines, committed to providing tailored services. With expertise in Web Development, e-Commerce Management, Data Analytics, and Graphic Design, we offer globally competitive solutions that empower our clients’ businesses to excel in today’s market.



By design, we combine your vision for your brand with our creative and technical capabilities to design the right user experience. We make sure that your customers or users discover your product not only appealing, but also useful.



Empowering your company with cutting-edge software solutions. Our skilled team adapts to tech trends, ensuring your excellence in innovation through development.



With BPO, we aim to enhance efficiency and service delivery with our versatile business support. We evolve to offer swift, improved customer service solutions.







The Opportunity

We are seeking a versatile, detail-oriented Marketplace Content & Creative Strategist to lead the development and optimization of product listings across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.



This role brings together keyword research, AI-assisted content writing, graphic design, and project management to produce high-performing listing assets and brand experiences. This is an ideal role for someone who thrives at the intersection of SEO, creative development, and cross-functional coordination, and who enjoys using modern AI tools to work efficiently and creatively.



Key Responsibilities

SEO & Content Development

• Conduct advanced keyword and market research using tools such as Helium 10, Data Dive, or similar platforms.

• Write and refine product listing content (titles, bullets, descriptions) using a combination of research, brand guidelines, and AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Jasper).

• Develop structured prompts, briefs, and templates to support high-quality AI-generated content at scale.

• Ensure content accuracy, brand consistency, and marketplace compliance across all listings.



Graphic Design & Creative Production

• Create, refine, and optimize graphics for Amazon and marketplace listings, including lifestyle graphics, feature callouts, infographics, and A+ content modules.

• Use a suite of AI-enhanced design tools including:

- ChatGPT Premium for creative ideation, prompt writing, visual concepting

- Freepik Premium for assets, templates, and illustration resources

- Adobe Photoshop Generative Fill for product cleanup, scene enhancements, and creative editing

- Canva AI Upscaler for resolution improvements and design composition

- Google AI Studio for advanced generative image and asset creation

- Nano Banana AI for enhanced mockups, image variations, and visual refinements

• Translate keyword and SEO insights into effective visual storytelling and conversion-oriented design.

• Collaborate with internal team to iterate on creative assets and ensure compliance with marketplace image standards.

• Maintain high production quality across all visual assets.



Project Management & Cross-Functional Workflow

• Manage end-to-end listing optimization projects, from kickoff through final delivery.

• Coordinate with SEO, design, account management, and brand teams to keep projects on schedule.

• Use project management tools and Google Workspace and Asana to organize workflows, gather inputs, and track deliverables.

• Oversee quality assurance for both content and design before listings go live.





Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience in e-commerce content strategy, listing optimization, creative production, or project management.

• Strong SEO research skills with Amazon-focused tools (e.g., Helium 10, Data Dive).

• Proven ability to manage multiple content and creative projects simultaneously.

• Experience with generative AI platforms and developing effective prompts.

• Demonstrated graphic design abilities using Photoshop, Canva, or equivalent tools.

• Excellent organization, communication, and self-editing skills

• Comfortable with Google Workspace tools and project management systems.



Nice-to-have

• Experience working with multiple brands or in an agency environment.

• Familiarity with Amazon’s image, copy, and compliance guidelines.

• Ability to review performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, rank) to inform content and creative decisions.

• Understanding of UX/UI-driven marketplace design principles.



Work Setup

• Independent Contractor - 40 hours per week

• Remote or work-from-home arrangement

• Time Schedule: US hours (8:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST or night shift in PH)

• Time tracker: Time Doctor

• Observance of US Holidays (Or willingness to work during PH holidays)

• Salary - depending on the qualifications



If you’re passionate about e-commerce, creative content, and turning data-driven insights into compelling marketplace experiences, we’d love to hear from you. Join our team and play a key role in creating optimized, engaging, and high-converting product listings across leading e-commerce platforms.



You may apply through this job posting or through this company website link;

title: YouTube Scriptwriter — Mysteries & Unexplained Events
description:
I’m looking for a strong, independent writer to create engaging YouTube scripts about strange sightings, unexplained events, and unusual encounters.



For examples of the writing quality I’m looking for—simple language, conversational delivery, and storytelling that’s extremely easy to follow—see:



• Carolina Case Files: 

• Lighthouse Mysteries: 

• MrBallen: 



PAY & DETAILS



• $100 USD per script, including research.

• 3,000–3,600 words per script.

• Freelance position with potential for ongoing work.

• Topics and writing guidelines will be provided.



INDEPENDENT WORK



You must be able to handle the entire script yourself: research, fact-checking, structure, writing, and proofreading.



Scripts must be complete and ready to narrate when submitted. I should not need to rewrite sentences, simplify the language, correct factual errors, or restructure the story.



The purpose of this position is to take scriptwriting off my plate. If I have to revise your work, this arrangement does not make sense for me. You need to understand the guidelines and consistently deliver finished scripts independently.



TOPICS



Strange sightings, unexplained events, and unusual encounters. No true crime. Choose stories with safe outcomes for everyone involved.



THE WRITING



Scripts must be extremely easy to follow, engaging, and natural when read aloud. Think of someone telling you a fascinating story in everyday language.



Absolutely no flowery language. None. No poetic descriptions, elaborate metaphors, or sentences dressed up to sound impressive.



For example:



• Don’t write: “An eerie silence draped itself over the sleepy town.”

  Write: “The town was quiet.”



• Don’t write: “The moon cast its silver veil across the lonely stretch of asphalt.”

  Write: “The moon lit the road.”



• Don’t write: “An icy wave of terror gripped him as he gazed upon the mysterious figure.”

  Write: “He was frightened when he saw the figure.”



The writing must not sound AI-generated at all. No robotic phrasing, generic suspense lines, awkward transitions, or repeated points.



I’m looking for a strong opening, a clear sequence of events, and interesting details that keep people listening. Let the events make the story interesting.



Research each topic carefully, provide source links, and distinguish documented facts from witness accounts or speculation. Do not invent details or dialogue. Include pronunciation guides in parentheses for unfamiliar names and places.



TO APPLY



Use Ghost as the subject line of your application and include:



1. Why you would be a good fit, including any relevant writing experience.

2. At least one existing writing sample. Multiple samples are preferred.

3. Links to published videos using your writing, if available, and your role in creating them.

4. Your usual turnaround time for a 3,000–3,600-word script.



I’m hoping to find a reliable writer for a long-term working relationship.
